# Norway vs Denmark, UEFA Nations League, 24 September 2026: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- UEFA's official match record decides the outcome. Flashscore is the fallback ([Flashscore match/odds page](https://www.flashscore.com/match/football/denmark-0KUdxQVi/norway-8rP6JO0H/odds/)), then Sofascore. Only the 90 minutes plus stoppage time count, so a draw resolves "No".
- I did not use any result data, because the exercise only allows sources published by 2026-09-18.

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-18 the match had not been played, and nothing settles the question in advance. It is the first match of Norway's first League A campaign. [soccergraph](https://www.soccergraph.com/2026/02/norway-uefa-nations-league-fixtures-schedule-date-start-time-venue.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-09-18: Both teams named squads for the September window. Solbakken reportedly picked 25 players, led by Haaland and Ødegaard and including the Benfica pair Aursnes and Schjelderup. Portugal had a new coach, Jorge Jesus. [Portugal Post](https://theportugalpost.com/posts/nations-league-rivals-name-squads-as-jorge-jesus-prepares-portugals-first-squad)
- September 2026: Solbakken warned Norway not to underestimate Denmark "despite the Danish crisis". Denmark missed the 2026 World Cup, and coach Brian Riemer is under pressure. [Flashscore](https://www.flashscore.com/news/soccer-uefa-nations-league-coach-solbakken-urges-norway-not-to-underestimate-denmark-despite-danish-crisis/AXSqpmwP/)
- September 2026, previews of undetermined date (possibly after 09-18):
  - Denmark is reported to be without Dolberg, Christensen and Højbjerg through injury, and its defence is described as shaky.
  - Haaland has about 62 goals in 55 caps, including 7 at the 2026 World Cup.
  - Ødegaard and Nusa are the other key Norway attackers.
  - [Football Whispers](https://footballwhispers.com/blog/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-preview-24-09-2026/), [Khel Now](https://khelnow.com/football/norway-vs-denmark-preview-uefa-nations-league-202609), [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/norway/uefa-nations-league/preview/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-team-news-lineups_605603.html)
- Norway's September window also includes Portugal at home. The squad will be managing its load across the group, which also contains Wales. [soccernews](https://www.soccernews.com/we-are-not-a-low-block-team-norway-to-take-the-game-to-portugal/405778/)

## 4. Base rates
- Head to head clearly favours Denmark:
  - Denmark is unbeaten in the last six meetings (4 wins, 2 draws), and one source counts the last seven as 4 wins and 3 draws.
  - Norway has not beaten Denmark since 2000 and has not beaten them at home since 1994.
  - The most recent meeting was a 3-1 Denmark win in a June 2024 friendly.
  - All five previous meetings in Norway saw both teams score.
  - Sources disagree on the totals. [ESPN](https://africa.espn.com/football/match/_/gameId/401861046/denmark-norway), [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/norway/uefa-nations-league/preview/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-team-news-lineups_605603.html)
- Current form:
  - Norway has won 14 of its 24 Nations League matches, about 58%, but all of those came in Leagues B and C.
  - Norway qualified for the 2026 World Cup.
  - Denmark has won 1 of its last 5 completed games.
  - [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/norway/uefa-nations-league/preview/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-team-news-lineups_605603.html)
- General rule of thumb: in evenly matched European internationals, home teams win roughly 45% of the time and about 25% end in draws.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Bookmaker prices from previews (the exact publication dates are unclear and may be after 09-18):
  - Norway at 1.80 with Betfred, roughly 53-55% implied after removing the bookmaker margin. [Football Faithful](https://thefootballfaithful.com/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-betting-tips-24-09-2026/)
  - Norway at 1.70 with Bet365, roughly 56-58% implied. [Betshoot](https://www.betshoot.com/football/202455-Norway-vs-Denmark-prediction/)
- Tipsters generally picked a Norway win. [Football Whispers](https://footballwhispers.com/blog/norway-vs-denmark-prediction-preview-24-09-2026/), [LiveScore](https://www.livescore.com/en/news/football/norway-denmark-predictions/)
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Fitness of Haaland and Ødegaard, and Denmark's injury list. A Flashscore piece talks about "surprises in lineups" from both coaches. [Flashscore](https://www.flashscore.com/news/soccer-uefa-nations-league-riemer-and-solbakken-spring-surprises-in-lineups-for-norway-denmark-clash/lleWzt6t/), [World Soccer Talk](https://worldsoccertalk.com/amp/news/is-erling-haaland-playing-today-projected-lineups-for-norway-vs-denmark-in-2026-27-uefa-nations-league-group-d)
- Club fixtures on 19 to 21 September could cause late withdrawals.
- Norway plays Portugal at home three days later, on 27 September, which could lead Solbakken to rotate.

A caveat on sourcing: several previews are undated, and the proxy blocked me from opening them, so the details above come from search-result summaries rather than full reads.
